Course detail API verified working on live (200) and local (200 returns full course data + lessons). Root cause was port mismatch / missing DATABASE_URL on old service. gto-api.service on port 8001 has correct config.

DSN normalization fix already committed (272bb19): strategy_storage.py line 136 strips +asyncpg suffix before passing to asyncpg.create_pool(). Verified: strategy-lookup returns 200 on valid params, 404 on missing (not 500). 368 tests pass.

Fixed e2e test runner: auto-install playwright in e2e/ dir, defaulted to single chromium project for local runs (5-project matrix only in CI), added e2e/node_modules/ to gitignore. 6/6 smoke tests pass in 15s, 104/118 all tests pass. 368 poker-core tests pass.

Verified: /hand-history page exists (1352 lines, fully functional), POST /api/v1/hh/parse endpoint works, parser supports PokerStars/GGPoker/Winamax, 44 parser tests pass. Task was already implemented.
Verified: /equity/plo4 and /plo4 both exist and return 200 live. Task was already implemented.
Verified: POST /api/v1/solver/postflop-strategy endpoint exists in solver.py with in-memory caching + live solver fallback. Task already implemented.

Fixed hardcoded potSize=0,stackDepth=0 in StreetBreadcrumb to pass real values. CardDisplay, action buttons, street breadcrumb, GTO comparison, config panel all present. Verified live: viewport-filling layout works, card styling improved, street breadcrumb shows proper progression, action buttons with GTO frequencies render, 0 JS errors. Solver dedup verified in test (19/19 pass).

Added _dedup_actions() helper that deduplicates solver actions by name keeping max frequency. Applied to postflop-strategy (cache + live-solver) paths and solve endpoints. 19/19 solver API tests pass including new dedup test. 368 poker-core tests pass.

Verified complete: FEATURES.yaml has 0 missing entries. All 12 live pages return 200. API on port 8001 serves strategy-lookup, quiz, spots, courses, all endpoints OK. 14 DB tables present (quiz_spots=54 rows, 40 with board data). Solver container up. No code changes needed — task was already done by prior sessions, checkpoint just needed advancing.

Replace position numbered buttons with player tiles showing position label + stack depth. Active tile in brand green (#00C853) with glow effect, inactive tiles in dark gray (#2A2A2A) with white text. Updated mobile responsive CSS. 387 tests pass, build clean.

Added top bar with Cash/bb/spots/Upgrade — game type label, stack depth dropdown (30-200bb), spots counter (2,000+), green-outlined Upgrade CTA. #1A1A1A bg, #333 border. Responsive wrapping on mobile. 368 tests pass, build clean.

Added action prompt header row between position tiles and hand matrix. Shows 'Your action: [RAISE/CALL/FOLD]' with GTO frequency from selected hand or most-frequent position action. Displays pot size (3.0bb) and effective stack. Color-coded action label, reactive to position/board/street changes. 368 tests pass, frontend build clean.
